Officials Arrested for Accepting Bribes in Separate Incidents

Two separate incidents have led to the arrest of government officials for allegedly accepting bribes. In Barnala, a Cooperative Inspector was apprehended while receiving Rs 50,000. In Kathua, a revenue official was arrested by the ACB for a similar offense. These arrests highlight ongoing efforts to combat corruption within public services.
